audit.seo_title: Free SEO audit of your website — technical check in Slovakia
audit.seo_desc: A free SEO audit: technical checks, speed, Google indexing and the errors keeping your site from bringing in customers. Delivered within 3 working days.
audit.h1: Free SEO audit of your website
audit.lead: I go through your site the way Google sees it and tell you exactly what stops it bringing you customers. No fee, no obligation.
audit.why_text: Because it is the most honest way to start. Most sites carry two or three technical faults that quietly take most of the traffic, and until you see them there is no point discussing the price of anything else. Fix them yourself and I am glad. Don't, and at least you know exactly what you are buying.
check_points: Technical foundation: status codes, redirects, www and non-www versions, HTTP against HTTPS — the faults that can make a site invisible to Google.
Indexing: how many pages are actually in Google, which are missing and why. Sitemap, robots.txt, canonical, hreflang.
Speed and Core Web Vitals on mobile and desktop, with the actual causes rather than just a score.
Content and queries: what the site shows up for today, at which positions, and what it needs to reach the first page.
Structured data and how the site looks in search results.
Measurement: whether Google Analytics and Tag Manager actually record enquiries or only page views. This is the most common surprise.
Competitors: who holds your queries in Slovakia and what they have that you don't.
get_points: Findings ordered by impact rather than alphabetically — from what costs you most down to the details.
For each finding, what to do about it and how much work it really is.
What you can fix yourself and what needs a change in the code.
An estimate of which fixes pay off soonest.
time_points: Send your website address through the form below.
Within 3 working days you get the audit in writing.
If you want, we go through it together — in person in Bratislava or online.
audit.who_text: Companies in Slovakia whose site exists but brings no enquiries. Online shops paying for ads without knowing what comes back. And anyone whose site was built by someone else and who is not sure it was done properly.
audit.trust_text: Kirill Mosin, White Eagles & Co. s.r.o. I have lived in Slovakia for more than 10 years, launched 12+ sites for Slovak companies, and know how buyers and institutions behave here. I invoice with a Slovak company number. We speak Slovak, Russian and English.
audit.cta_title: Want to know what is holding your site back?
audit.cta_text: Send your address — I will come back with the audit within 3 working days.

faq.a: Yes. I charge nothing for it and it is not tied to an order. It is a way to meet over real work rather than a presentation.
Up to 3 working days from when you send the address. For large online shops it can take up to 5 days, and I say so in advance.

faq.q: Do you need access to my site?
faq.a: Not for a basic audit — a public address is enough. Access to Google Search Console and Analytics makes it considerably more accurate, because I can see real queries and visitor behaviour.

faq.q: What if I want to fix things myself?
faq.a: Go ahead. The audit is written so it can be worked through without me. If you get stuck, get in touch.

faq.q: Do you audit sites you did not build?
faq.a: Mostly those, in fact. It does not matter whether it runs on WordPress, Shoptet or custom code.

faq.q: What if the site is fine?
faq.a: Then I say so. It is rare, but it happens. In that case the conversation is about content and winning more enquiries, not about repairs.
